Hi Larkspur team,

I was thinking of hiring your Countess for our company launch event - it would be great to get her on board. We'd need to pick her up on Wednesday 5 May 2027 at 11:30 and then bring her back on the 6th of May 2027 at 09:00, collecting her from your garage. According to your website, the total comes to 576.00 euros. I've attached a copy of my driving licence for your records.

Cheers,
Silas Sedgewick-Rowe
